universal_rules: NOT APPLICABLE is a structural state, not a verdict, and is excluded from every evaluable denominator. Regenerated from this run: D3a = 4, D4a = 1. (Generated by R/16_verify.R on every run -- never typed. The v56 text asserted 'only D3a (24) and D3b (19) use this state', which was wrong on every figure; a later hand-correction then went stale the moment the corpus moved.)

A CONFIRMED MISFIT rests on documented evidence and never on silence alone, by exactly one of three evidentiary routes. (a) ABSENCE-EVIDENCED: the documents state that the provision is absent or the actor excluded. (b) DESIGN-EVIDENCED: the documents state a design choice that itself creates the barrier and document no alternative, which covers D3b's reimbursement route and D4a's transferred maintenance duty. (c) DOCUMENTATION-EVIDENCED: the programme documents its other provisions to the depth typical of the corpus and is silent on this one, so the misfit is evidenced by what the programme publishes. The route behind every misfit is reported in 05_misfit_route_composition.csv, and the paper states that a misfit is evidenced by the public record rather than that silence equals misfit.
PARTIAL FIT requires at least one required element to be present, verified across all seven components. A record meeting no element cannot reach partial fit.

INDETERMINATE means undeterminable rather than unexamined, and it is used only where the evidence genuinely cannot settle the requirement. Where a requirement is disjunctive and one disjunct is documented absent while the other is silent, the record is indeterminate but sub-classified so that the stronger evidential position stays visible.

VERDICTS POOL INTO A PROFILE AND NEVER INTO AN INDEX. The seven verdicts are never summed, averaged, weighted or ranked into a single fitness score, and a programme is described by its profile across the seven relational tests.

DOCUMENTED DESIGN ONLY. Every verdict evaluates what the programme's public documentation states rather than what the programme achieves, and no state is evidence of an ecological, social or administrative outcome.
THE PIPELINE IS THE SOLE AUTHORITY. Verdicts exist only as pipeline output, and any verdict column in a dataset file is written from the pipeline rather than maintained alongside it.
APPLICABILITY IS SETTLED BEFORE FITNESS. A condition that does not arise for a programme is recorded as not applicable rather than scored, so it cannot be read as either success or failure.

D1.name: Ecological-functional
D1.fit: objectives and measures both documented AND every objective matched by a functionally plausible measure
D1.status: VALIDITY FLOOR — fit rate is flat across objective count (93.6/94.4/94.9%); must not be reported as an alignment finding

D2.name: Tenure & authority access
D2.misfit: two or more short, or route explicitly closed
D2.na: none — every band generates a requirement
D2.status: ABSORBS the former D2b. Consent is tested before the direct branch.

D3a.name: Technical enablement
D3a.fit: high demand: standards AND advice; medium: advice AND standards; low: technical guidance AND establishment support
D3a.status: PURGED of administrative variables. Two thirds of remaining fits sit at the minimum threshold — a floor test, not a depth measure.

D3b.name: Financial accessibility
D3b.partial: pre-financing with documented in-kind or discount alternative
D3b.misfit: documented route requires pre-financing, no alternative documented
D3b.na: 19 records whose E-22 documents no participant-facing cash transaction; kept separate from the 75 whose timing is undocumented
D3b.status: Report WITH the strict explicit-absence sensitivity; the headline misfit count alone overstates.

D3c.name: Administrative access
D3c.fit: clarity >= 2 AND submission >= 2, counting DISTINCT provisions (each variable contributes at most 1)
D3c.status: REBUILT and STRICTENED. Prior threshold was distribution-driven (raised because 88% fell in one band). Weighted-depth counting let one full-value variable clear an axis (29 fits rested on guide+forms alone); distinct-provision counting makes that structurally impossible. 189 fits rather than 329.

D4a.name: Stewardship
D4a.inputs: F-5 (who carries the duty) · E-17 (binding condition) · E-15/E-16/E-18 (support, graded material vs informational)
D4a.fit: Duty transfer documented (F-5 = applicant or shared) AND material support documented (E-15 grant, E-16 covered costs, E-18 site visit or inspection reminder).
D4a.partial: Duty transfer documented AND the only support documented is informational (E-18 guide or helpdesk): instruction without capacity.
D4a.misfit: Duty transfer documented AND no support of any kind documented. The misfit rests on the DOCUMENTED TRANSFER -- a positive published design decision -- not on silence about support. Same shape as D3b's documented reimbursement route with no documented alternative.
D4a.indeterminate: F-5 not stated: the transfer cannot be established. Never a misfit.
D4a.na: City or utility retains the duty: no transfer occurs, so the test has no object.

D4b.name: Monitoring
D4b.fit: published measurable indicators OR recurring scheduled review
D4b.misfit: F-1 and F-3 both explicitly No
D4b.status: Webpage tier excluded from the indicator flag; this is the strictest domain and should stay so.

typology_sizes._note: Includes the unprofiled opacity group, so the entries total the 707 analysed records rather than the 673 the three macro classes cover.

typology_stability.stable_claim: The three-class macro-partition is the only eligible solution whose classes all exceed the 0.75 bootstrap Jaccard convention.
typology_stability.unstable_element: Class boundaries within the finer partition.

settled_questions.D4a_no_misfit_route: VERIFIED against data: 215 records impose a binding duty, 0 explicitly refuse all three supports. Rule kept.
settled_questions.D2_three_tenure_bands: VERIFIED: Spearman(renter share, reach)=0.065 (flat); data tertile cuts agree 95.2%. Bands kept.

D1 Ecological.threshold: every stated objective matched by a functionally plausible measure
D1 Ecological.literature: Zheng 2021 (green-roof retention meta-analysis, 2,375 obs); Kumar 2024 (cooling by measure type)
D1 Ecological.assessment: ALIGNED. The literature supports plausibility-only, which is exactly the validity-floor reading we report.

D2 Tenure & authority.threshold: route reach >= what the tenure band requires (3 bands, 4 reach levels)
D2 Tenure & authority.literature: Astmarsson 2013 (landlord/tenant dilemma); Snep 2023 (social housing as the vehicle); Pellerey & Giezen 2026; Matsler 2023
D2 Tenure & authority.assessment: MOSTLY ALIGNED, ONE OPEN QUESTION. 61 renter-majority cities score full fit on a consent-dependent route. Raising the renter-majority requirement to tenant-in-own-right moves 137 records BUT demotes 62 social-housing/co-op routes to misfit - contradicting Snep 2023. Reported as a stated limit, not silently resolved.

D3a Technical.threshold: demand class decides which technical element is required
D3a Technical.literature: Nawrath 2026 (incentives for blue-green infrastructure); Gunawardena & Steemers 2020 (living-wall maintenance)
D3a Technical.assessment: ALIGNED. Notably the literature-preferred alternative RAISES fit, so the adopted rule is the conservative one.

D3b Financial.literature: Toxopeus & Polzin 2021 (financing barriers); Matsler 2023 (equity scan of GSI incentives); Malinowski 2020 (fee credits)
D3b Financial.assessment: ALIGNED and deliberately harsh. Report with its explicit-absence sensitivity.

D3c Administrative.threshold: KNOW core (D-1) AND LODGE core (D-3), each satisfiable once
D3c Administrative.literature: Matsler 2023 (procedural barriers in GSI incentive programmes)
D3c Administrative.assessment: ALIGNED but the widening requirement is defensible. Disclose that the equity-scan reading would be stricter.

D4a Stewardship.threshold: responsibility named AND any support form (financial or not)
D4a Stewardship.assessment: THE WIDEST GAP IN THE SET. The funded-only reading collapses fit to 3.1%. That is itself the finding - report BOTH figures, never the 55.4% alone.

D4b Monitoring.threshold: webpage summary counts as a met element at partial strength
D4b Monitoring.assessment: THE MOST JUDGEMENT-DEPENDENT THRESHOLD. Disclose the tier explicitly and report both.
